title: Introduce RAG step-debugger Skaffold quickstart
author: Samira Patel
release_notes: Adds a new local-focused quickstart: a Skaffold-backed step debugger for RAG workflows. Useful for iterative authoring, replay-driven tests, and telemetry-driven quality checks.
description:
Motivation: debugging retrieval-augmented generations (RAG) end-to-end is hard when feedback loops span vector stores, model variants, and tool calls. This quickstart introduces a light-weight "step debugger" dev loop powered by Skaffold and a local replay proxy so authors can iterate on prompts, index snapshots, and tool mocks without heavy infra.

What this PR adds: a new quickstart at quickstarts/rag-skaffold-step-debugger that includes: a reproducible Docker devcontainer, skaffold.yaml for iterative rebuilds, a small replay server (node) that replays indexed documents and deterministic model stubs, telemetry probes that capture token-level timing and simulated KV-cache hits, and a short authoring guide (docs/rag/authoring/debugger.md). The replay harness supports an in-memory vector store and deterministic seeds for evals so test suites can assert exact agent decisions.

Key features / rationale: - Skaffold-based dev loop for fast rebuild+redeploy during prompt iteration. - Local replay proxy lets engineers record a session and replay scenarios for regression testing. - Telemetry scrubber included to remove tenant data from recorded sessions before sharing with product or SRE. - Lightweight deterministic model stubs allow CI to run smoke assertions without hitting hosted models.

Usage (quick start): - git checkout HEAD && ./quickstarts/rag-skaffold-step-debugger/scripts/bootstrap.sh - Start local replay server: ./examples/rag/replay-server/start.sh - Start Skaffold dev loop: skaffold dev - Open the authoring guide and follow the "record -> mutate -> replay -> assert" loop.

Checklist (author): - [x] Add quickstart scaffold and README - [x] Skaffold config + devcontainer - [x] Replay server and telemetry probes - [x] Smoke CI workflow for quickstart - [x] Docs page with usage and security notes

Security/Privacy notes: The telemetry scrubber (examples/rag/replay-server/probes/telemetry-scrubber.py) is documented and runs as part of the bootstrap script. By default recorded traces are stored under ./quickstarts/rag-skaffold-step-debugger/.replays and the README explains how to upload sanitized traces to Linear for triage. Do not check real customer data into the repo.

Related work: follows ENG-1248 (devloop improvements) and complements PRs that added replay and telemetry primitives. See also: PR #824761 (simulated-tool-assertion-harness) for test assertions patterns.

Testing: local smoke tests included in .github/workflows/quickstart-ci.yml run the replay server and assert deterministic agent output for two scenarios (faq-lookup, multi-tool-order). CI runs in the matrix against node 18 and the lightweight python env for telemetry scripts.

Notes for reviewers: the replay server is intentionally tiny and documented; we avoided introducing new external dependencies by default (only devDependencies for the devcontainer). Feedback requested on the default replay retention policy and whether the devcontainer should include a pre-built index snapshot for first-run convenience.
